message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• 65 mph on rural two‑lane highways. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• No “seat‑belt law” for adults in Texas, but failure to buckle can lead to a fine if the driver is pulled over. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Move‑over” law: vehicles must change lanes or slow down when approaching emergency vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Vehicles must stop in both directions on two‑lane roads. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display a valid registration sticker.
• Towing a vehicle requires a valid license and insurance. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or within 20 ft of a crosswalk.
• Pay‑and‑display or meter required in many cities. | City ordinances; TxDOT | | **Traffic Signal & Road Markings** | • Red light: stop.
• Yellow light: prepare to stop.
• Green light: proceed (unless a stop sign or red light is present). | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Bicyclists must ride in the lane if possible.
• Motorcycles must use the right side of the lane. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT**: [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) – for road conditions, speed limits, and construction updates. - **TxDMV**: [https://www.txdmv.gov](https://www.txdmv.gov) – for registration, insurance, and driver’s license information. - **Texas Transportation Code**: Available online through the Texas Legislature’s website or legal databases. ### Quick Tips 1. **Always check for posted signs** – speed limits and special rules can vary by county or city. 2. **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on the phone. 3. **Keep your insurance documents in the vehicle** – you may need to show them if stopped. 4. **Be extra cautious near school zones** – speeds are often reduced and enforcement is strict. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or have a particular scenario in mind, let me know!
